# Vtiger | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Integrated SMB CRM | The main link, “List or interactive entry - formation of a customer and business - push phase - triggers the next step - manage the disc”, is to verify whether integrated SMB CRMs actually reduce manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Sales to Support | Using “list or interactive entry - customer formation and business opportunities - advance phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - manage the double disk, to verify whether sales to support actually reduce manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Stock sales | Using “lists or interactive entry - customer formation and business opportunities - advance phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - manage the double disk, to verify whether stock-type sales actually reduce manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Multisectoral sharing of client information | Using “lists or interactive entry - formation of clients and business opportunities - push phase - triggers the next step - manage the double drive” as the main link to verify whether multisectoral sharing of customer information actually reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
